topic_thesis: Buying gold at an all-time high isn't 'safe' investing; it is providing exit liquidity for institutional sellers who bought at half the price.
strategic_angle: Expose the 'safe haven' myth by contrasting the emotional comfort of gold ownership with the brutal reality of historical price cyclicality and the 3% GST + 10-15% making charges that instantly destroy your principal value.
key_statistic: 18% immediate loss on investment due to GST, making charges, and the 10-year mean reversion risk.
target_emotion: Shock and immediate urge to check personal accounts
